channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: West Asia crisis: Kuwait reduces oil output citing Iran threats to Strait of Hormuz shipping
item.description: In a statement on March 7, the state-run Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC) said the move was part of a “risk management and business continuity strategy” amid growing security threats in the region. KPC did not disclose how much output had been reduced.

item.title: West Asia disruptions: Air India to run 30 extra flights today, IndiGo resumes Europe ops; check full schedule
item.description: Air India said it was continuing regular operations on certain routes despite the regional disruptions

item.title: 'More flights are planned': 52,000 Indians return from Gulf amid Iran war disruption
item.description: In those countries where commercial flight operations are unavailable, Indian nationals are advised to contact the Embassy/Consulate for advice regarding the nearest available commercial flight options

item.title: US-Israel-Iran War Live: Israel strikes Tehran's fuel storage facilities; Iran targets water desalination plant in Bahrain
item.description: US-Israel-Iran War Live updates: IAF struck oil complexes, where the Iranian regime would distribute fuel to multiple military entities in Iran, says IDF

item.title: West Asia crisis: Iran fires 10 ballistic, 2 cruise missiles at Qatar
item.description: Qatar said most of the incoming projectiles were intercepted by its air defenses, and no casualties were reported. Two ballistic missiles fell into territorial waters while two others struck an uninhabited area

item.title: Why the Iranian regime has not collapsed yet - and may not for now
item.description: In the middle of the war, people are not going to rebel to support an invading military, says Iranian-American expert Vali Nasr

item.title: Are GCCs quietly redrawing the leadership map for women in India?
item.description: Corporate India continues to struggle with the mid-career drop-off among women leaders, even as the country’s booming GCC ecosystem quietly builds a new generation of globally visible women executives.

item.title: 'Iran bragged about 60% enriched fuel, enough for 11 bombs': Trump envoy reveals what happened in first talks
item.description: "We have negotiating leverage, maybe maximum. But we are not looking to settle. They are going to settle, we are not going to settle," says Trump

item.title: Rs 1,085 crore bank fraud: CBI files another case against Anil Ambani, RCom on PNB complaint
item.description: The case was registered on March 5 following a complaint filed by Punjab National Bank, which accused the borrowers of cheating two public sector lenders between 2013 and 2017
